resources.name: Open‑source DFT software (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO, GPAW)

access.notes: Any open‑source DFT code supporting PBE PAW and periodic boundary conditions (Quantum ESPRESSO, GPAW, CP2K) is acceptable.

resources.name: PAW pseudopotentials for Zr, Sn, Nb (PBE)

access.notes: SSSP efficiency library or PSlibrary pseudopotentials consistent with the chosen DFT code.

resources.name: Reference crystal structures (α‑Zr, β‑Sn, bcc Nb)

access.notes: α‑Zr: hcp, a=3.232 Å, c=5.147 Å; β‑Sn: tetragonal, a=5.832 Å, c=3.182 Å; bcc Nb: a=3.300 Å. These are widely known and can be obtained from public databases (e.g., Materials Project) or from the literature.
